description: Fresco in a monastic refectory, Lombardy, c. 1510, heavily overpainted. Christ sits at the centre of a long table with ten apostles. Twelve loaves and a dish of fish are laid on the cloth.
definition: Christ at table with the twelve apostles

variantes.description: Fresque d'un réfectoire monastique, Lombardie, vers 1510, très repeinte. Le Christ est assis au centre d'une longue table avec dix apôtres. Douze pains et un plat de poissons sont posés sur la nappe.
Fresco, Lombardy, c. 1510. Ten apostles are seated with Christ, who occupies the centre of a long table; on the cloth lie twelve loaves and a dish of fish.
Fresco, Lombardy, c. 1510. Christ sits at the centre of a long table with the twelve apostles. Ten loaves and a dish of fish are laid on the cloth.

Fresco, Lombardy, c. 1510, heavily overpainted. Christ sits at the centre of a long table with apostles whose number can no longer be read. The contract of 1509, preserved in the convent archive, specified the twelve apostles.
Fresco, Lombardy, c. 1510, heavily overpainted. Christ sits at the centre of a long table with what are probably ten apostles. Twelve loaves are laid on the cloth.
Fresco, Lombardy, c. 1510. Christ sits at the centre of a long table with ten apostles. A servant brings a jug from the left. Twelve loaves are laid on the cloth.
Fresco, Lombardy, c. 1510. Christ sits at the centre of a long table with ten apostles. No halo is painted round any head.
